notes.title: Now Available - Luxor Evolved, 10% Off
notes.notes:
Luxor Evolved is now available on Steam and is 10% off until March 8th at 10AM Pacific Time!

In this all-new, completely revamped Luxor adventure, the chains are faster, the power-ups more awesome, the shooters more stealthy. Revisiting the arcade classics, LUXOR Evolved is action packed with 65 unique levels, addicting effects and sound tracks. This number one marble shooter game has tons to keep the challenges coming and keep you firing!

notes.title: New Release - Luxor: 5th Passage
notes.notes:
Luxor: 5th Passage is now available on Steam and is 30% off for the first week!

Get ready to wield your winged-scarab shooter in an all-new LUXOR, the #1 action-puzzle game of all time! Save ancient Egypt in the 100-level Adventure mode, or test your accuracy in the all-new Blast mode.

Discount ends February 1st at 10am Pacific Time.
